caption:
Moving to a new city or country always comes with new challenges and new experiences! Last year moving to Ahmedabad made me conquer my fear of cooking Indian food! Even though I’m back home already, the joy I found cooking simple Indian dishes still stays with me and is something I do 6/7 days a week :) 

Ingredients
- 120 grams toor dal, soaked for an hour before we start 
- 1 large onion, finely chopped 
- 1 large tomato, finely chopped
- 3 green chillis, finely chopped 
- 1 small bunch chopped coriander 
- 1 tbsp red chilli powder
- 1 tsp turmeric powder
- 1.5 tsp Garam masala
- 1 tbsp coriander powder 
- 1 tsp salt
- 450 ml water 

For tadka,
- 2 tbsp ghee
- 10 cloves of garlic, chopped
- 3-4 dried red chillies
- pinch of red chilli powder and hing

- 2 tbsp Kasturi methi
